bullets.id: Emas naik 0,63% ke $4.165,40 pada Selasa karena yield AS mundur dari level tertinggi 24 tahun dan dolar melemah. Rabu pagi kenaikan itu sebagian hilang: emas turun 0,44% ke $4.146,42 saat minyak kembali naik setelah serangan tanker Iran di Selat Hormuz dan bentrokan Saudi-Houthi.
bullets.en: Gold rose 0.63% to $4,165.40 on Tuesday as US yields pulled back from 24-year highs and the dollar eased. On Wednesday morning part of that gain faded: gold fell 0.44% to $4,146.42 as oil rebounded after Iranian tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and Saudi-Houthi clashes.

bullets.id: Yield 10 tahun masih di kisaran 5,27–5,3% dan indeks dolar di sekitar 102,06. Brent naik 0,82% ke $101,41. Pasar memperkirakan sekitar 80% peluang Fed menahan suku bunga bulan ini, tetapi risiko kenaikan Desember masih tinggi. Emas turun 4,81% sebulan dan sekitar 26% di bawah rekor Januari $5.608.
bullets.en: The 10-year yield is still in the 5.27–5.3% area and the dollar index is near 102.06. Brent rose 0.82% to $101.41. Markets price about an 80% chance the Fed holds rates this month, but the risk of a December hike remains high. Gold is down 4.81% on the month and about 26% below its January record of $5,608.

bullets.id: Kitco menandai resistance di $4.180–4.190, lalu $4.214 dan $4.238, dengan support di $4.142,71 dan $4.000–4.020. Risalah FOMC September terbit Rabu pukul 14.00 ET (Kamis dini hari WIB), disusul klaim pengangguran Kamis dan sentimen konsumen Jumat.
bullets.en: Kitco marks resistance at $4,180–4,190, then $4,214 and $4,238, with support at $4,142.71 and $4,000–4,020. The September FOMC minutes are out Wednesday at 2:00 p.m. ET (early Thursday WIB), followed by jobless claims on Thursday and consumer sentiment on Friday.

bullets.id: Antam naik Rp10.000 ke Rp2.580.000/gram dan buyback naik Rp15.000 ke Rp2.391.000, sehingga spread menyempit ke Rp189.000 (sekitar 7,3%). Galeri24 Rp2.510.000 (buyback Rp2.366.000) dan UBS Rp2.534.000 (buyback Rp2.340.000). Bank sentral membeli bersih 39 ton emas pada Agustus, dipimpin China 20 ton.
bullets.en: Antam rose Rp10,000 to Rp2,580,000/gram and buyback rose Rp15,000 to Rp2,391,000, narrowing the spread to Rp189,000 (about 7.3%). Galeri24 is at Rp2,510,000 (buyback Rp2,366,000) and UBS at Rp2,534,000 (buyback Rp2,340,000). Central banks bought a net 39 tonnes of gold in August, led by China with 20 tonnes.
